name: chitchat
description: Real-time chat: WebSockets + Redis Pub/Sub + Kafka write buffer + MongoDB, React/Zustand client with optimistic UI

scripts.build: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test:api: node tests/api.test.mjs && node tests/idempotency.test.mjs && node tests/unread-pagination.test.mjs
scripts.test:stack: node tests/cross-instance.test.mjs && node tests/failover.test.mjs && node tests/kafka.test.mjs
